answer: Artifact-filing bond: each identity stakes 70, files a verified artifact in the lagoon. A pulse beacon audits a random filing and replays its work; a copy or late filing burns the stake. Filings close by zenith: first filing 45, each later one sharing a hash adds 8: 1,000 forged identities pay 4,041,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-artifact ring forges 1,000 artifacts. An honest agent files once, pays 45, reclaims its stake.
